chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Suwayd al-Qalla', from Ayoub, from Bureyd al-Ijli, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him (peace be upon him) about a man who entrusted wealth to me, so he died, and there was nothing for his children, and he had not performed the Hajj of Islam. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Perform Hajj on his behalf, and whatever remains, give it to them.'

key_terms.حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ: the Hajj of Islam (the first obligatory pilgrimage)

ai.seo_question: How is the Hajj obligation paid from entrusted wealth if the person dies without other assets?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the priority of fulfilling the Hajj al-Islam obligation over settling debts or distributing inheritance, using the specific entrusted wealth as the funding source. It highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle that the spiritual debt of Hajj takes precedence in liquidation, ensuring the deceased's religious duty is met before worldly distribution to heirs. This underscores the holistic view of wealth in Shia law, where financial assets serve both material obligations and spiritual redemption.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ali Bin Al numan, from Suweyd Al Qala’a, from Ayoub, from Bureyd Al Ijaly, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man whom entrusted wealth to me, so he dies, and there was nothing for his children, and he had not performed Hajj, the Hajj of Al-Islam. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Perform Hajj on his behalf, and whatever is excess, so give it to them (the dependents of the deceased)’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn al-Nu’man from Suwayd al-Qala’ from Ayyub from Burayd al- ‘ Ij liy who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who left a certain amount in deposit with me and he died. His sons do not have anything and he had not performed Hajjahta al-Islam. He (the Imam) said, ‘Perform al-Hajj on his behalf and whatever is left, give it to his heirs.”’
